title: Before Adam
summary: A semi-autobiographical novel by Jack London in which the protagonist experiences vivid dreams of a prehistoric past as his ancient ancestor, Big-Tooth. The story explores themes of evolution, racial memory, and primal instincts through the dual perspective of modern man reflecting on his evolutionary heritage. It follows Big-Tooth's struggles for survival among early hominids, including conflicts with primitive creatures, social dynamics within a prehistoric tribe, encounters with Fire People, and the haunting influence of ancient fears and memories.
